findings.title: Task-framing comparison uses incommensurate and conditioned endpoints
findings.assumptions: Same-class nondegenerate unit boxes; target unit square; predictions shifted horizontally by 1/9 and 2/3; comparison uses the pinned library's conditional pairwise mean
findings.decisive_evidence: IoUs 4/5 and 1/5 yield thresholded means 1/2 at 0.1 and 4/5 at 0.5, unchanged predictions. Disjoint false positives are omitted by both means. Mask pixel metrics have a different unit from instance AP/recall.
findings.alternative_readings: Conditional IoU is a valid descriptive overlap metric; AP is also reported. Current code does not prove historical experiment provenance.
findings.core_dependency: Local conclusion that segmentation is a better real-world framing; dataset contribution survives
findings.impact_bound: Does not invalidate existence, scale or usefulness of dataset, or establish corrected benchmark values

repair.statement: Label averaging and endpoints; use a shared instance-localization evaluator for cross-framing comparisons.
